title: Wave-like amplification of near-threshold two-particle reactions: from muon-catalyzed fusion to $Λ\barΛ$ production at $e^-e^+$ annihilation
summary: A simple model is proposed to explain the recently found wave-like enhancement of the $Λ\barΛ$ pair production near the threshold at the $e^-e^+$ annihilation, which allows extracting model-independent scattering parameters and spectral information for the $Λ\barΛ$ pair from the oscillatory nature of the measured cross section. In particular, it predicts a single bound state of $Λ\barΛ$ with a binding energy of $\varepsilon_{Λ\barΛ}=(36\pm5)$MeV.
